page.title: AI Control Center
page.subtitle: Connect your AI providers, choose the models and keep spending under control. Everything here belongs to {{organization}} only.
page.noAccessTitle: You can't view the AI settings
page.noAccessBody: Your role in this organization doesn't include access to the AI Control Center. Ask an administrator if you need it.
page.readOnly: You can view this page, but only administrators can change it.

state.unavailableBody: We couldn't reach the AI service. Your settings are safe. Try again in a moment.

overview.notConfigured: AI isn't set up yet. Add an API key and a model to start.
overview.needsModel: A provider is connected but no model is enabled yet. Add a model to start.
overview.ready_one: AI is ready: {{count}} provider connected, {{models}} enabled.
overview.ready_other: AI is ready: {{count}} providers connected, {{models}} enabled.
overview.limitReached: The {{period}} spending limit has been reached. AI requests are blocked until it resets.
overview.nearLimit: {{period}} spending is at {{percent}}% of the limit.

provider.title: Provider keys
provider.subtitle: Each organization uses its own keys. Keys are encrypted when saved and never shown again: only the last four characters stay visible.
provider.label: Label: {{label}}
provider.noKey: No key saved for this provider.
provider.onlyAdmins: Only administrators can add or change keys.

form.help: Paste the key from your {{provider}} account. It is sent over HTTPS, stored encrypted and never displayed again.
form.label: Label (optional)
form.verify: Check the key with {{provider}} before saving
form.verifyHint: A lightweight request to the provider. If it fails, the key isn't saved.

revokeConfirm.title: Revoke this key?
revokeConfirm.message: {{provider}} stops working for {{organization}} until you add a new key. The stored key is erased and can't be recovered.

model.title: Model catalog
model.subtitle: You define the model names, capabilities and prices. Prices are never filled in for you: copy them from your provider's pricing page.
model.emptyHint: Discover the models your key can use, or add one by name.

price.cachedNote: Without a cached price, cached tokens are charged at the input price.

model.noCredential: No active key for this provider.
model.unpriced: No price set: blocked while a spending limit is active.

form.modelIdHint: Exactly as the provider names it.
form.capabilitiesHint: Tick only what the provider confirms for this model.
form.cachedHint: Only if the provider publishes a different price for cached prompt tokens.
form.priceHint: Leave empty if you don't know it. The model then can't be used while a spending limit is active.
form.invalidNumber: Enter a number of 0 or more.

discoverDialog.title: Models available to {{provider}}
discoverDialog.intro: These names come straight from {{provider}} using your key, so their availability is confirmed. Capabilities and prices aren't: you confirm them when you add a model.
discoverDialog.empty: {{provider}} returned no models for this key.

removeConfirm.title: Remove this model?
removeConfirm.message: {{model}} leaves the catalog and the routes that use it. Past usage records stay.

routing.title: Routing
routing.subtitle: Choose the main model for each task and the models to try next. Fallbacks run only when the provider is rate limiting, timing out or unavailable, never for key, quota or request problems.
routing.implicit: No route set: the first enabled model is used.
routing.usesDefault: No route set: follows the default route.
routing.needsModels: Add a model first to create a route.

usage.title: Usage
usage.costNote: Cost is computed from the provider's reported tokens and the prices you set. Models without a price show no cost.
usage.perDayEmpty: No cost recorded in this period.
usage.empty: No AI requests in this period.

budget.title: Spending limits
budget.subtitle: Limits are checked before every request. Windows are in UTC: the daily limit resets at 00:00 UTC and the monthly limit on day 1.
budget.none: No limit set: spending isn't capped.

form.title: {{period}} limit
form.hint: Use 0 to block all AI requests in this window.
form.invalid: Enter an amount of 0 or more.

removeConfirm.title: Remove the {{period}} limit?
removeConfirm.message: Spending in this window won't be capped anymore.

errors.authentication: The provider rejected the API key.
errors.permission: The key doesn't have access to this.
errors.quota: The provider reports that the account has no credit or quota left.
errors.rate_limit: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
errors.timeout: The provider took too long to answer.
errors.unavailable: The provider is unavailable right now.
errors.invalid_request: The provider couldn't process the request.
errors.not_found: The model isn't available at the provider.
errors.content_blocked: The provider blocked the request or the answer.
errors.invalid_response: The provider returned an unusable answer.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.forbidden: Your role doesn't allow this action.
errors.notFound: Not found. It may have been removed.
errors.conflict: That already exists or isn't allowed right now.
errors.invalid: The server rejected the data. Check the fields.
